name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but behind the scenes. After a decade in corporate HR, a chance encounter with a racing team owner sparked a passion for the high-octane world. He saw an opportunity to apply his expertise in talent management to a unique and demanding environment.

At United Autosports, Jean-Pierre is known for his meticulous approach to recruitment and employee relations. He believes in fostering a supportive and inclusive team culture, where every member feels valued and empowered. Jean-Pierre stands out for his ability to identify and nurture talent, ensuring that the team has the best possible people in every role.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre has a commanding presence with a warm, approachable smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters in his office.
Insists on a weekly team lunch to build camaraderie.
